description: This source file defines an internal class AllStreamNamespacesPredicate that implements the IChannelNamespacePredicate interface. It provides a predicate pattern matching all namespaces and a method to determine if a given namespace matches the pattern.

classes.name: AllStreamNamespacesPredicate
classes.description: An internal class that matches all stream namespaces via a wildcard pattern.

methods.name: PredicatePattern
methods.description: Returns the pattern string for matching namespaces, which is '*' indicating all namespaces.

methods.name: IsMatch
methods.description: Determines if the given stream namespace matches the predicate, always returns true.
